ROUTE 15 NORTH CORRIDOR PROJECTS
For the next several years, Loudoun County and the Virginia Department of Transportation
(VDOT) will be initiating construction for the following planned Capital Improvement Projects
along the Route 15 north corridor from the Town of Leesburg to the Virginia/Maryland state line.
DESCRIPTION CURRENT STATUS
Route 15 Widening 1

This Loudoun County project includes the design, land acquisition and construction UTILITIES
to widen Route 15 from two to four lanes between Battlefield Parkway and
Montresor Road. 2
Phase 1 will widen Route 15 from Battlefield Parkway to White’s Ferry Road. LAND &
DESIGN
Phase 2 will widen Route 15 from White’s Ferry Road to Montresor Road.
Route 15/Spinks Ferry Road/Newvalley Church Road Roundabout
This Loudoun County project consists of the design, right-of-way acquisition, utility
DESIGN
relocation and construction of a roundabout on Route 15 at Spinks Ferry Road and
a realigned Newvalley Church Road.
Route 15 Lucketts Bypass
This Loudoun County project provides for the planning, design and construction of PLANNING
a new segment of Route 15 around the west side of the Village of Lucketts.
The project includes a shared use path along the southbound lanes of the bypass.
Route 15 and Lovettsville Road Intersection
This Loudoun County project provides the planning, design, right-of-way
DESIGN
acquisition, and construction of intersection improvements on Route 15 at
Lovettsville Road. The purpose of this project is to improve safety at this intersection.
